g.text: Sequence Diagram - Consult and Search Stock Periods
validate Product ID or search filters / pagination / historical
SELECT Product joined with stock WHERE ended_at IS NULL
SELECT Product and stock periods using historical filter
The stock API uses one resource root: /api/v1/stock.
Search defaults to current periods (endedAt IS NULL).
historical=true returns only completed periods (endedAt IS NOT NULL).
Product ID, name and optional isActive filters are combined;
omitting isActive includes active and inactive Products.
Results include startedAt and nullable endedAt and are paginated.
Inactive Products remain consultable and searchable by the
Manager. Product.isActive does not determine whether stock
tracking exists; an open StockInformation period does.
